tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: Quote stock tokens and ETFs on Robinhood Chain by ticker (NVDA, TSLA, SPY…) or token address, one or up to 20 at once. Returns the pool price, 24h change and pool depth where a pool exists.

tools.name: stock_movers
tools.description: Today’s movers among stock tokens on Robinhood Chain, ranked by the pool’s 24h change. tradeable_only keeps the ones you can buy now.

tools.name: stock_portfolio
tools.description: The stock tokens and ETFs a wallet holds on Robinhood Chain, with amounts and value in dollars, plus its ETH.

tools.name: build_trade
tools.description: Build unsigned transactions to buy a stock token on Robinhood Chain with ETH (`eth`, or `usd` worth of ETH) or sell `pct` percent of the wallet’s holding for ETH. `token` is a ticker (TSLA) or the token address. A buy needs the ETH, plus gas, already in `wallet`; if it is short, fund it with fund_ag

tools.name: gift_stock
tools.description: Build an unsigned buy of a stock token on Robinhood Chain that goes to another wallet as a gift: `wallet` pays with its ETH (`usd` worth, or `eth`), and the token arrives at `recipient` in the same transaction. Use it only when the user asks to send, give or gift a stock to an address; for the user’

tools.name: fund_agent
tools.description: Quote moving funds from another network (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, bnb, polygon and others, 15 in all, or a chain ID) to an agent wallet on Robinhood Chain, arriving as ETH. `payer` is the wallet that already holds the funds on the origin network: if the user did not name it, ask, do not r

tools.name: my_key
tools.description: What your keyfo key can still use: its allowance, what is left and when it resets. Without a key: how many free read calls are left this hour.

tools.name: morpho_rates
tools.description: Morpho on Robinhood Chain: USDG vaults with their net APY, size and curator, and the lending markets that take stock tokens as collateral, with the borrow rate and LLTV. Rates change; the numbers are a snapshot. Pass a ticker for one stock.

tools.name: morpho_loop
tools.description: Work out the net result over a year of borrowing USDG against a stock token on Morpho and putting it in a USDG vault, and the price at which the loan would be liquidated. A calculation at current rates, not advice: nothing is built or sent.

tools.name: build_morpho_deposit
tools.description: Build unsigned transactions to deposit USDG into a Morpho vault on Robinhood Chain, or to withdraw it. Without a vault, the largest USDG vault is used. Vaults carry smart contract, curator and market risk. Returns calls for the wallet owner to sign and send in order on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The AI models a keyfo key can call: price per million tokens, context length and what each supports (tools, reasoning, vision, json). Filter by what the task needs; a trial key sees its low-cost list. Listing is free.

tools.name: model_detail
tools.description: One model in detail: prices, context, what it supports, and what a call of a given size would cost.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.description: Ask another AI model (GPT, Gemini, Grok and others) one question through keyfo and get its answer, for a second opinion. This is a paid model call: it needs a key and draws from the key’s daily allowance at the model’s price. A trial key can ask low-cost models only. The other model gets no tools.

tools.name: stock_approvals
tools.description: Open token approvals of a wallet on Robinhood Chain: the stock tokens keyfo lists, USDG and WETH, checked against the spenders keyfo knows, such as LI.FI and Permit2. It does not scan the wallet’s whole approval history. Unlimited approvals come first.

tools.name: build_revoke
tools.description: Build an unsigned transaction that sets a token approval back to zero, so that spender can no longer move the token. Needs a key. tools.name: chain_status
tools.description: The state of Robinhood Chain: the latest block and its age, the average block time, the gas price, and an estimate of what a transfer and a stock swap cost in dollars.

tools.name: explain_tx
tools.description: A Robinhood Chain transaction in parts: whether it succeeded, who sent it to what, the function it called, its fee, and every token transfer and approval it made.

tools.name: schedule_buy
tools.description: Plan a weekly buy of a stock token on Robinhood Chain for `wallet`: `usd` or `eth` each week on `weekday` at `hour` in `tz`. Nothing is bought or signed now. tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: The buy plans of `wallet`: token, amount, day, hour and time zone, status and the next time. Read only.

tools.name: cancel_schedule
tools.description: Cancel a buy plan by its `id`. Nothing new is prepared for it; buys already signed stay as they are.

tools.name: pending_signs
tools.description: Scheduled buys of `wallet` that are ready to sign now, each with its sign_url and when its window closes. Read only. Show the user every link.

tools.name: buy_at_price
tools.description: Plan a buy of a stock token on Robinhood Chain for `wallet` that waits for a price: when the pool price goes `trigger` below or above `price_usd`, keyfo prepares a buy of `usd` or `eth` and a sign link. Nothing is bought or signed now. The plan starts after the wallet’s owner confirms it at https://

tools.name: portfolio_pnl
tools.description: Profit and loss for the stock tokens a wallet holds on Robinhood Chain, read only, no key needed: average entry price, unrealized P&L per token and in total. tools.name: portfolio_brief
tools.description: A short brief for one wallet on Robinhood Chain, read only: each stock token it holds with value and 24h change, the portfolio total, and today’s top three movers you can buy. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "gift_stock" is 1235 chars, far longer than this server's median (240). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
